doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.session_review.reviewer_name.label: Reviewer name

runner.session_review.reviewer_role.label: Reviewer role
runner.session_review.reviewer_role.short_description: Stores the reviewer role associated with the current package-level review.
runner.session_review.reviewer_role.definition: Reviewer role is the formal role or title associated with the recorded package reviewer.
runner.session_review.reviewer_role.process_note: Use the role/title that should persist into the package approval record.

runner.session_review.default_approver.label: Default approver
runner.session_review.default_approver.short_description: Stores the planned approver for the package-level signoff path.
runner.session_review.default_approver.definition: Default approver is the expected signoff authority for the current deliverable scope.
runner.session_review.default_approver.process_note: Set this to the person expected to approve the current report or validation package.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.session_review.default_approver_r.label: Approver role
runner.session_review.default_approver_r.short_description: Stores the formal role of the planned approver for the package-level signoff path.
runner.session_review.default_approver_r.definition: Approver role is the role/title associated with the expected signoff authority.
runner.session_review.default_approver_r.process_note: Use the formal title that belongs in the package approval record.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.session_review.decision.label: Decision
runner.session_review.decision.short_description: Records the current package-level approval decision.
runner.session_review.decision.definition: Decision is the shared review/signoff outcome carried into the report context and approval summary.
runner.session_review.decision.process_note: Set this only after the review basis and scope are correct for the current package.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.session_review.acceptance_basis.label: Acceptance basis
runner.session_review.acceptance_basis.short_description: Records the approval basis used to justify the current package-level decision.
runner.session_review.acceptance_basis.definition: Acceptance basis is the formal basis state attached to the package review and signoff record.
runner.session_review.acceptance_basis.process_note: Keep this aligned with the actual deliverable scope and decision state.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.session_review.signoff_by.label: Signoff by
runner.session_review.signoff_by.short_description: Stores the approving person for the current shared review signoff.
runner.session_review.signoff_by.definition: Signoff by is the person recorded as the package approver in the final approval metadata.
runner.session_review.signoff_by.process_note: Populate this at actual signoff time so the approval record reflects the true approver.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.session_review.signoff_role.label: Signoff role
runner.session_review.signoff_role.short_description: Stores the approver role for the current shared review signoff.
runner.session_review.signoff_role.definition: Signoff role is the formal role/title associated with the recorded approving person.
runner.session_review.signoff_role.process_note: Use the formal approver title that belongs in the package approval record.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.session_review.notes.label: Session Review Notes
runner.session_review.notes.short_description: Stores package-level reviewer observations, limitations, and release notes.
runner.session_review.notes.definition: Session review notes are the shared package-review remarks carried into report context and approval records.
runner.session_review.notes.process_note: Use this for substantive review observations or package constraints that should survive into the final record.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.session_review.signoff_note.label: Session Review Signoff Note
runner.session_review.signoff_note.short_description: Stores the explicit approval conditions, restrictions, or rejection basis attached to signoff.
runner.session_review.signoff_note.definition: The signoff note is the package-level approval narrative associated with the recorded decision.
runner.session_review.signoff_note.process_note: Use this to preserve approval conditions, exceptions, or a specific rejection basis.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.client_name.label: Client name
runner.report.client_name.short_description: Stores the client name used in the formal report package.
runner.report.client_name.definition: Client name is the project customer or client identifier carried into the report context and final deliverable.
runner.report.client_name.process_note: Use the formal client name that should appear in the final report.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.facility_owner.label: Facility owner / operator
runner.report.facility_owner.short_description: Stores the facility owner or operator name used in the formal report package.
runner.report.facility_owner.definition: Facility owner / operator is the owner/operator identity carried into the report context and final deliverable.
runner.report.facility_owner.process_note: Use the formal facility owner or operator name expected in the final report.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.test_company.label: Test company
runner.report.test_company.short_description: Stores the test company responsible for the project execution or report package.
runner.report.test_company.definition: Test company is the organization performing the test program and preparing the deliverable package.
runner.report.test_company.process_note: Use the formal test company name that should appear in the final report.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.laboratory.label: Laboratory
runner.report.laboratory.short_description: Stores the laboratory identity used in the formal report package when applicable.
runner.report.laboratory.definition: Laboratory is the lab name carried into the report context for analytical or organizational reference.
runner.report.laboratory.process_note: Use this when a lab identity belongs in the final package.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.session_operator.label: Session operator
runner.report.session_operator.short_description: Stores the session operator name carried into the formal report context.
runner.report.session_operator.definition: Session operator is the operator identity associated with the active test session and final report context.
runner.report.session_operator.process_note: Use the person or operator identity that should appear in the formal package.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.responsible_official.label: Responsible official
runner.report.responsible_official.short_description: Stores the responsible official identified for the final report package.
runner.report.responsible_official.definition: Responsible official is the formal accountable official carried into the final report and approval context.
runner.report.responsible_official.process_note: Use the actual responsible official expected to appear in the deliverable.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.responsible_title.label: Responsible title
runner.report.responsible_title.short_description: Stores the official title of the responsible official in the final report package.
runner.report.responsible_title.definition: Responsible title is the formal title associated with the recorded responsible official.
runner.report.responsible_title.process_note: Use the title that should appear verbatim in the report.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.agency_contact.label: Agency contact
runner.report.agency_contact.short_description: Stores the relevant agency contact context for the formal report package.
runner.report.agency_contact.definition: Agency contact is the project regulatory contact carried into the report context when applicable.
runner.report.agency_contact.process_note: Use this when the report package needs to preserve the project agency contact.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.process_narrative.label: Process Narrative
runner.report.process_narrative.short_description: Stores the report-ready narrative describing the source, duty, and operating context.
runner.report.process_narrative.definition: Process narrative is the formal descriptive narrative used in the final report to explain the source and test context.
runner.report.process_narrative.process_note: Write this in report-ready language because it can flow directly into the formal deliverable.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.control_equipment_descript.label: Control Equipment Description
runner.report.control_equipment_descript.short_description: Stores the report-ready description of any relevant control equipment.
runner.report.control_equipment_descript.definition: Control equipment description is the formal narrative describing control devices and relevant operating context for the source.
runner.report.control_equipment_descript.process_note: Use this when the report should describe control devices or control-side operating context.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.planned_deviations.label: Planned Deviations
runner.report.planned_deviations.short_description: Stores planned or pre-approved departures from the standard procedure.
runner.report.planned_deviations.definition: Planned deviations are the preplanned or pre-approved departures from standard execution preserved in the formal package.
runner.report.planned_deviations.process_note: Use one item per line so the package and report can preserve each deviation cleanly.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.field_deviations.label: Field Deviations
runner.report.field_deviations.short_description: Stores observed field deviations that occurred during testing.
runner.report.field_deviations.definition: Field deviations are the actual departures from expected execution observed during the test program.
runner.report.field_deviations.process_note: Use one item per line and keep the text factual and review-ready.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.alternative_method_approva.label: Alternative Method / Approval References
runner.report.alternative_method_approva.short_description: Stores the identifiers for alternative methods, approvals, or related supporting references.
runner.report.alternative_method_approva.definition: Alternative method / approval references are the formal permit, email, or approval identifiers preserved in the report package.
runner.report.alternative_method_approva.process_note: Use one item per line so each approval or reference remains distinct in the final record.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.impact_statement.label: Impact Statement
runner.report.impact_statement.short_description: Stores the statement describing whether deviations or approvals affected validity or interpretation.
runner.report.impact_statement.definition: Impact statement is the report-ready explanation of whether recorded deviations or approvals affected data validity, comparability, or interpretation.
runner.report.impact_statement.process_note: State the impact clearly so the final report can preserve the conclusion without rework.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.report.correspondence_notes.label: Regulatory / Correspondence Notes
runner.report.correspondence_notes.short_description: Stores regulatory and correspondence context carried into the final report package.
runner.report.correspondence_notes.definition: Regulatory / correspondence notes summarize NOI, agency coordination, ERT/CEDRI status, and related project correspondence context.
runner.report.correspondence_notes.process_note: Use this for concise summary context, not full correspondence transcripts.

wizard.pollutants.selection.label: Pollutant Selection
wizard.pollutants.selection.short_description: Enables or disables a pollutant in the active project selection set.
wizard.pollutants.selection.definition: Pollutant selection drives the downstream QA/QC profile, method resolution, and Test Matrix autogeneration contract.
wizard.pollutants.selection.process_note: Select only the pollutants that are actually in scope for the project so the downstream workflow resolves correctly.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows
MOLE DAS Technical and Operating Manual
doc_refs.section: Pollutants -> QA/QC profile/method auto-population -> Test Matrix autogeneration

wizard.pollutants.active.label: Active Pollutant
wizard.pollutants.active.short_description: Selects which enabled pollutant is currently being edited in the active pollutant prescription panel.
wizard.pollutants.active.definition: The active pollutant is the current pollutant context used for pollutant-specific configuration fields on the right-hand editor panel.
wizard.pollutants.active.process_note: Use this to switch between enabled pollutants when reviewing or editing pollutant-specific settings.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.pollutants.expected_max.label: Expected Max
wizard.pollutants.expected_max.short_description: Stores the expected maximum concentration for the active pollutant.
wizard.pollutants.expected_max.definition: Expected Max is the pollutant-specific expected concentration ceiling used for span suggestion and setup context.
wizard.pollutants.expected_max.process_note: Enter a realistic upper-bound expectation for the active pollutant so downstream suggestions and review context remain defensible.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.pollutants.units.label: Units
wizard.pollutants.units.short_description: Stores the expected engineering units for the active pollutant.
wizard.pollutants.units.definition: Units determine the engineering basis for the active pollutant’s expected maximum and related setup context.
wizard.pollutants.units.process_note: Use the engineering units that match the actual measurement basis for the pollutant.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.pollutants.method_selected.label: Method (Selected)
wizard.pollutants.method_selected.short_description: Shows or selects the pollutant-specific method basis currently associated with the active pollutant.
wizard.pollutants.method_selected.definition: Method (Selected) is the pollutant-level method selection used as input to the effective-method and QA/QC resolution logic.
wizard.pollutants.method_selected.process_note: Review this for the active pollutant and keep it aligned with the intended method basis for the project.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.pollutants.cal_points_selected.label: CAL Points (Selected)
wizard.pollutants.cal_points_selected.short_description: Stores the active pollutant’s selected calibration-point count.
wizard.pollutants.cal_points_selected.definition: CAL Points (Selected) is the pollutant-specific selected calibration-point posture before effective QA/QC resolution.
wizard.pollutants.cal_points_selected.process_note: Use AUTO unless a controlled reason exists to override the pollutant’s selected calibration-point count.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.pollutants.lin_points_selected.label: LIN Points (Selected)
wizard.pollutants.lin_points_selected.short_description: Stores the active pollutant’s selected linearity-point count.
wizard.pollutants.lin_points_selected.definition: LIN Points (Selected) is the pollutant-specific selected linearity-point posture before effective QA/QC resolution.
wizard.pollutants.lin_points_selected.process_note: Use AUTO unless a controlled reason exists to override the pollutant’s selected linearity-point count.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.pollutants.nox_converter_efficien.label: NOx Converter Eff.
wizard.pollutants.nox_converter_efficien.short_description: Enables the optional NOx converter efficiency workflow for the active pollutant when applicable.
wizard.pollutants.nox_converter_efficien.definition: NOx Converter Eff. is the pollutant-level switch for adding the optional converter-efficiency workflow to the active pollutant prescription.
wizard.pollutants.nox_converter_efficien.process_note: Use this only when the active pollutant and project configuration require the converter-efficiency workflow.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.qaqc.sig_digits.label: Sig digits (display)
wizard.qaqc.sig_digits.short_description: Controls the display precision used in QA/QC-facing numeric presentation.
wizard.qaqc.sig_digits.definition: Sig digits (display) defines the displayed significant-digit precision used in QA/QC-facing calculations and review surfaces.
wizard.qaqc.sig_digits.process_note: Use the project’s intended review/display precision and avoid changing this casually once a project is underway.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.qaqc.portable_track.label: Portable Track (2-point typical)
wizard.qaqc.portable_track.short_description: Sets the QA/QC posture to the portable-track configuration where that project mode applies.
wizard.qaqc.portable_track.definition: Portable Track is the QA/QC project posture used for portable-style workflows with the typical two-point approach.
wizard.qaqc.portable_track.process_note: Enable this only when the project is intentionally using the portable-track QA/QC posture.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.qaqc.diag_optin_cal_lin.label: DIAG + Record+Token: include Cal/Linearity capture anyway (opt-in)
wizard.qaqc.diag_optin_cal_lin.short_description: Allows a diagnostics-flavored project to capture calibration and linearity evidence when intentionally opted in.
wizard.qaqc.diag_optin_cal_lin.definition: This opt-in overrides the default diagnostics posture for the limited purpose of including calibration and linearity capture anyway.
wizard.qaqc.diag_optin_cal_lin.process_note: Use this only when the project intentionally needs Cal/Linearity capture despite the diagnostics posture.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.category.label: Source Category
wizard.source.category.short_description: Classifies the physical source category so the Wizard can constrain downstream source logic and equipment defaults.
wizard.source.category.definition: Source category is the top-level source classification used to drive source application options, engine-specific fields, and related normalization assumptions.
wizard.source.category.process_note: Set this first in the Source Schema section because downstream fields such as Application, Engine Cycle, and Cylinder Count depend on it.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows
MOLE DAS Technical and Operating Manual

wizard.source.application.label: Application
wizard.source.application.short_description: Describes the source application within the selected source category.
wizard.source.application.definition: Application is the source-use classification beneath the top-level source category and is used to preserve equipment context in the session package.
wizard.source.application.process_note: Select the application that best matches the tested source after setting Source Category.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows
MOLE DAS Technical and Operating Manual

wizard.source.service_class.label: Service Class
wizard.source.service_class.short_description: Captures whether the source is stationary, portable, mobile, offshore, or unknown.
wizard.source.service_class.definition: Service class is a source-context descriptor used to distinguish the operating deployment class of the equipment.
wizard.source.service_class.process_note: Use the actual deployment class of the tested equipment so the project record stays defensible.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.output_type.label: Output Type
wizard.source.output_type.short_description: Records whether the source output is mechanical, electrical, thermal, or unknown.
wizard.source.output_type.definition: Output type is the functional output classification of the tested source and helps preserve the equipment context in the session record.
wizard.source.output_type.process_note: Choose the output type that matches the actual work produced by the source.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.engine_cycle.label: Engine Cycle
wizard.source.engine_cycle.short_description: Stores the engine cycle class used for engine-specific regulatory and equipment context.
wizard.source.engine_cycle.definition: Engine cycle distinguishes two-cycle, four-cycle, or unknown engine classification for source records where the source category is Engine.
wizard.source.engine_cycle.process_note: Populate this only for engine sources. Leave the source category correct first so the field is enabled only when appropriate.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.engine_cyl_count.label: Cylinder Count
wizard.source.engine_cyl_count.short_description: Stores the engine cylinder count for engine sources.
wizard.source.engine_cyl_count.definition: Cylinder count is the equipment-specific engine count used for source identification and regulatory/equipment context where applicable.
wizard.source.engine_cyl_count.process_note: Enter this only for engine sources and use the actual installed cylinder count.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.manufacturer.label: Manufacturer
wizard.source.manufacturer.short_description: Identifies the equipment manufacturer for the tested source.
wizard.source.manufacturer.definition: Manufacturer is the equipment-maker field carried in source metadata and used by the equipment catalog picklists.
wizard.source.manufacturer.process_note: Use the manufacturer that matches the actual tested equipment. Review the model defaults after selection.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.model_number.label: Model Number
wizard.source.model_number.short_description: Identifies the equipment model for the tested source.
wizard.source.model_number.definition: Model Number is the equipment model identifier carried in the source record and used by catalog-driven defaults where available.
wizard.source.model_number.process_note: Use the actual model identifier for the tested equipment. This may drive catalog defaults in the source form.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.serial_number.label: Serial Number
wizard.source.serial_number.short_description: Captures the equipment serial number for source identification.
wizard.source.serial_number.definition: Serial Number is the source-specific equipment serial identifier recorded in project metadata and supporting documentation.
wizard.source.serial_number.process_note: Enter the actual equipment serial number used in field and report records.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.asset_tag.label: Asset Tag
wizard.source.asset_tag.short_description: Captures the local asset tag or plant identifier for the tested source.
wizard.source.asset_tag.definition: Asset Tag is the plant or operator-specific asset identifier that supplements model and serial information.
wizard.source.asset_tag.process_note: Use the facility’s actual asset tag when one exists so the project record matches field documentation.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.power_units.label: Power Units
wizard.source.power_units.short_description: Defines the engineering units used for rating and capacity inputs.
wizard.source.power_units.definition: Power Units determines the unit basis for the source rating and capacity values used in normalization context.
wizard.source.power_units.process_note: Choose the unit basis before entering rating values so Nameplate, Site Rated, and Estimated Operating stay coherent.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.max_power.label: Nameplate / Max
wizard.source.max_power.short_description: Stores the nameplate or maximum rated source capacity.
wizard.source.max_power.definition: Nameplate / Max is the maximum equipment rating preserved for source normalization context and reporting.
wizard.source.max_power.process_note: Enter the best-supported nameplate or maximum rating available for the tested source.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.site_rated_power.label: Site Rated
wizard.source.site_rated_power.short_description: Stores the site-rated or declared operating capacity for the source.
wizard.source.site_rated_power.definition: Site Rated is the source’s site-declared or permitted rating used when nameplate data is not the chosen normalization basis.
wizard.source.site_rated_power.process_note: Use the declared site-rated value when that is the operational rating the project intends to use.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.estimated_power.label: Estimated Operating
wizard.source.estimated_power.short_description: Stores an estimated operating rating when stronger rating evidence is unavailable.
wizard.source.estimated_power.definition: Estimated Operating is the fallback operating-capacity estimate used only when better rating evidence is not available.
wizard.source.estimated_power.process_note: Use this only as a fallback and prefer nameplate or site-rated values when available.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.load_basis.label: Load Basis
wizard.source.load_basis.short_description: Selects which rating basis should be treated as the current operating basis.
wizard.source.load_basis.definition: Load Basis declares whether nameplate, site-rated, or estimated capacity is the active basis for source normalization context.
wizard.source.load_basis.process_note: Choose the basis that matches the project’s defensible rating reference.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.fuel_flow_basis.label: Fuel Flow Basis
wizard.source.fuel_flow_basis.short_description: Declares whether fuel flow is metered, manual, estimated, or unset.
wizard.source.fuel_flow_basis.definition: Fuel Flow Basis is the data-quality posture for fuel flow information used in optional source and exhaust-flow logic.
wizard.source.fuel_flow_basis.process_note: Choose the strongest basis actually available and leave it unset when no fuel-flow value is being carried.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.fuel_flow_units.label: Fuel Flow Units
wizard.source.fuel_flow_units.short_description: Defines the engineering units used for optional fuel-flow values.
wizard.source.fuel_flow_units.definition: Fuel Flow Units stores the unit basis for the declared fuel-flow context and adapts to the resolved fuel family.
wizard.source.fuel_flow_units.process_note: Use units consistent with the source fuel family and the actual field or records basis.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.fuel_flow_variation_pct.label: Typical Variation (%)
wizard.source.fuel_flow_variation_pct.short_description: Captures the expected run-to-run fuel-flow variation percentage.
wizard.source.fuel_flow_variation_pct.definition: Typical Variation is an acknowledgement value representing expected run-to-run fuel-flow variability.
wizard.source.fuel_flow_variation_pct.process_note: Use a realistic variation figure if fuel flow is being carried into the source context.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.fuel_flow_ack.label: Acknowledge Fuel Flow Variation
wizard.source.fuel_flow_ack.short_description: Confirms that run-to-run fuel-flow variation is recognized for the current source context.
wizard.source.fuel_flow_ack.definition: This acknowledgement indicates that optional fuel-flow context may vary between runs and should be treated accordingly.
wizard.source.fuel_flow_ack.process_note: Check this when the project is intentionally carrying an approximate or variable fuel-flow context.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.source.exhaust_method.label: Exhaust Flow Determination
wizard.source.exhaust_method.short_description: Declares how exhaust flow will be determined for the source workflow.
wizard.source.exhaust_method.definition: Exhaust Flow Determination records whether exhaust flow is derived stoichiometrically, measured, or carried from manufacturer inputs.
wizard.source.exhaust_method.process_note: Choose the actual exhaust-flow determination basis planned for the project so downstream assumptions remain consistent.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.site.latitude.label: Latitude
wizard.site.latitude.short_description: Stores the site latitude in WGS84 coordinates.
wizard.site.latitude.definition: Latitude is the site-location coordinate used for weather and location-aware project context.
wizard.site.latitude.process_note: Use the actual test-site latitude or fetch coordinates before weather compilation.

wizard.site.longitude.label: Longitude
wizard.site.longitude.short_description: Stores the site longitude in WGS84 coordinates.
wizard.site.longitude.definition: Longitude is the site-location coordinate used for weather and location-aware project context.
wizard.site.longitude.process_note: Use the actual test-site longitude or fetch coordinates before weather compilation.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.site.station_id.label: Station ID
wizard.site.station_id.short_description: Stores the preferred weather-station identifier for site weather retrieval.
wizard.site.station_id.definition: Station ID is the site weather-reference identifier used to anchor weather compilation when a specific station is known.
wizard.site.station_id.process_note: Populate this when a preferred station is known; otherwise let the weather workflow resolve it from coordinates.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.site.elevation_ft_msl.label: Elevation (ft MSL)
wizard.site.elevation_ft_msl.short_description: Stores the site elevation above mean sea level in feet.
wizard.site.elevation_ft_msl.definition: Elevation is the site-location elevation used for environmental context and related computations.
wizard.site.elevation_ft_msl.process_note: Enter or fetch the site elevation in feet MSL so the site record stays internally consistent.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.site.mode.label: Weather Mode
wizard.site.mode.short_description: Declares whether site conditions are sourced automatically from weather data or managed manually.
wizard.site.mode.definition: Weather Mode controls whether the session relies on automatic weather retrieval or manual site-condition fallback.
wizard.site.mode.process_note: Use the mode that matches how site conditions will be maintained for the session.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.site.weather_fail.label: On Fetch Fail
wizard.site.weather_fail.short_description: Defines the failover behavior if automatic weather retrieval is unsuccessful.
wizard.site.weather_fail.definition: On Fetch Fail is the policy setting that determines how the session should behave when weather retrieval cannot complete as planned.
wizard.site.weather_fail.process_note: Choose the failover posture that matches the project’s tolerance for manual fallback versus interruption.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.site.auto_weather_compile.label: Auto-compile Weather Data
wizard.site.auto_weather_compile.short_description: Controls whether the session should compile weather data automatically for the site context.
wizard.site.auto_weather_compile.definition: Auto-compile weather data enables periodic weather compilation and later Runner backfill for the declared site coordinates and station.
wizard.site.auto_weather_compile.process_note: Enable this when the project intends to carry automatically compiled weather data in the session record.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.site.manual_t_amb_f.label: T_amb (degF)
wizard.site.manual_t_amb_f.short_description: Stores manual ambient temperature as an optional site-condition fallback value.
wizard.site.manual_t_amb_f.definition: Manual ambient temperature is the fallback temperature value used when the session relies on manually entered site conditions.
wizard.site.manual_t_amb_f.process_note: Use this only when manual site-condition fallback is part of the project’s site-conditions posture.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.site.manual_p_bar_psia.label: P_bar (psia)
wizard.site.manual_p_bar_psia.short_description: Stores manual barometric pressure as an optional site-condition fallback value.
wizard.site.manual_p_bar_psia.definition: Manual barometric pressure is the fallback pressure value used when the session relies on manually entered site conditions.
wizard.site.manual_p_bar_psia.process_note: Use this only when manual site-condition fallback is part of the project’s site-conditions posture.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.site.manual_rh_frac.label: RH (0-1)
wizard.site.manual_rh_frac.short_description: Stores manual relative humidity as an optional site-condition fallback value.
wizard.site.manual_rh_frac.definition: Manual RH is the fallback relative-humidity fraction used when the session relies on manually entered site conditions.
wizard.site.manual_rh_frac.process_note: Enter RH as a fraction from 0 to 1 when using manual site-condition fallback.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.site.z_model.label: Z Model
wizard.site.z_model.short_description: Defines the compressibility-factor model used for site-condition handling.
wizard.site.z_model.definition: Z Model is the compressibility-factor treatment used in the site-conditions context, including ideal or fixed-Z handling.
wizard.site.z_model.process_note: Use the project’s intended compressibility treatment and provide Fixed Z when that mode is selected.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

wizard.site.fixed_z.label: Fixed Z
wizard.site.fixed_z.short_description: Stores the fixed compressibility factor when a fixed-Z site-condition model is used.
wizard.site.fixed_z.definition: Fixed Z is the explicit compressibility-factor value carried when the site-condition posture uses a fixed-Z model.
wizard.site.fixed_z.process_note: Populate this only when the selected Z Model requires a fixed Z value.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.hp_mode.label: HP Input Mode
runner.method_input.hp_mode.short_description: Declares which horsepower/load input basis the run is using.
runner.method_input.hp_mode.definition: HP Input Mode selects whether horsepower is carried as direct horsepower, load fraction, or IMAP-derived load context.
runner.method_input.hp_mode.process_note: Choose the strongest actual run basis available so the Method 19 crosswalk and load context remain defensible.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.load_fraction.label: Load Fraction
runner.method_input.load_fraction.short_description: Stores the run load fraction when load-based horsepower input is used.
runner.method_input.load_fraction.definition: Load Fraction is the fractional engine load basis used to estimate horsepower for the current run.
runner.method_input.load_fraction.process_note: Use a 0 to 1 fractional value that matches the run-specific operating load basis.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.actual_hp.label: Actual HP
runner.method_input.actual_hp.short_description: Stores direct measured or declared brake horsepower for the current run.
runner.method_input.actual_hp.definition: Actual HP is the direct horsepower input used when the run has a known horsepower value instead of a derived load basis.
runner.method_input.actual_hp.process_note: Use this only when a direct run horsepower basis exists.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.imap_value.label: IMAP
runner.method_input.imap_value.short_description: Stores intake manifold pressure for IMAP-based horsepower estimation.
runner.method_input.imap_value.definition: IMAP is the intake manifold absolute or gauge pressure input used for IMAP-based load interpretation.
runner.method_input.imap_value.process_note: Use this only when the run is using IMAP mode and ensure the units field matches the entered value.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.imap_units.label: IMAP Units
runner.method_input.imap_units.short_description: Defines the engineering units used for the IMAP input.
runner.method_input.imap_units.definition: IMAP Units sets the pressure-unit basis for the run IMAP value and related idle/full calibration points.
runner.method_input.imap_units.process_note: Keep this aligned with the instrumentation or source record basis used for the run.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.imap_idle.label: IMAP Idle
runner.method_input.imap_idle.short_description: Stores the idle or minimum IMAP reference point used in IMAP mode.
runner.method_input.imap_idle.definition: IMAP Idle is the low-end reference point for interpreting current IMAP relative to the run’s operating envelope.
runner.method_input.imap_idle.process_note: Populate this when IMAP mode is used and the idle reference is known.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.imap_full.label: IMAP Full
runner.method_input.imap_full.short_description: Stores the full-load or maximum IMAP reference point used in IMAP mode.
runner.method_input.imap_full.definition: IMAP Full is the high-end reference point for interpreting current IMAP relative to the run’s operating envelope.
runner.method_input.imap_full.process_note: Populate this when IMAP mode is used and the full-load reference is known.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.imap_mid.label: IMAP Mid
runner.method_input.imap_mid.short_description: Stores an optional midpoint IMAP reference for non-linear IMAP interpretation.
runner.method_input.imap_mid.definition: IMAP Mid is an optional reference point between idle and full load used to improve IMAP-based load interpretation.
runner.method_input.imap_mid.process_note: Use this only when a midpoint reference belongs in the IMAP load model for the source.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.imap_mid_util.label: Mid Util
runner.method_input.imap_mid_util.short_description: Stores the utilization associated with the optional IMAP midpoint.
runner.method_input.imap_mid_util.definition: Mid Util is the load/utilization value paired with the optional IMAP midpoint reference.
runner.method_input.imap_mid_util.process_note: Enter this only when IMAP Mid is being used and the midpoint utilization is known.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.fuel_flow_value.label: Fuel Flow (this run)
runner.method_input.fuel_flow_value.short_description: Stores the run-specific fuel-flow value used for Method 19 stoichiometric handling.
runner.method_input.fuel_flow_value.definition: Fuel Flow is the current run fuel-flow basis used when exhaust flow is being determined stoichiometrically from fuel input.
runner.method_input.fuel_flow_value.process_note: Use the run-specific fuel-flow value that matches the declared units and fuel-flow basis.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.fuel_flow_units.label: Fuel Flow Units
runner.method_input.fuel_flow_units.short_description: Defines the engineering units for the run-specific fuel-flow value.
runner.method_input.fuel_flow_units.definition: Fuel Flow Units sets the engineering basis for the run fuel-flow value used in Method 19 stoichiometric handling.
runner.method_input.fuel_flow_units.process_note: Keep this aligned with the actual field or record basis for the run fuel-flow value.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.o2_dry_pct.label: O2 dry %
runner.method_input.o2_dry_pct.short_description: Stores dry-basis oxygen used in the Method 19 crosswalk or stack-measured helper path.
runner.method_input.o2_dry_pct.definition: O2 dry percent is the oxygen input used in oxygen-correction and Method 19 crosswalk logic when the operator provides an override.
runner.method_input.o2_dry_pct.process_note: Enter this only when the run needs an explicit operator-provided O2 value rather than the live analyzer feed.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Terms, Definitions, and References
MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.qd_dscfh.label: Qd dry dscfh
runner.method_input.qd_dscfh.short_description: Stores direct-entry dry standard exhaust flow for the current run.
runner.method_input.qd_dscfh.definition: Qd dry dscfh is the dry standard exhaust flow basis used when the operator provides direct stack-flow entry instead of deriving it from pitot inputs.
runner.method_input.qd_dscfh.process_note: Use this as the single direct-entry dry standard flow basis when it is known for the run.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.stack_flow_acfm.label: Stack flow (acfm)
runner.method_input.stack_flow_acfm.short_description: Stores direct-entry actual stack flow for the current run.
runner.method_input.stack_flow_acfm.definition: Stack flow ACFM is the actual cubic-feet-per-minute run flow used only when a direct actual-flow basis is being carried.
runner.method_input.stack_flow_acfm.process_note: Use this only when direct-entry stack flow is the chosen run basis and avoid mixing it with conflicting direct Qd values.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.stack_velocity_fps.label: Stack velocity (ft/s)
runner.method_input.stack_velocity_fps.short_description: Stores direct-entry stack velocity for the current run.
runner.method_input.stack_velocity_fps.definition: Stack velocity is the run-specific actual velocity basis carried only when the operator is using direct-entry measured velocity context.
runner.method_input.stack_velocity_fps.process_note: Use this only when the run has a defensible direct velocity basis and avoid duplicating conflicting direct-entry values.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.pitot_dp_inh2o.label: Pitot ΔP
runner.method_input.pitot_dp_inh2o.short_description: Stores average pitot differential pressure for the Method 2 helper path.
runner.method_input.pitot_dp_inh2o.definition: Pitot differential pressure is the Method 2 traverse pressure input used to calculate stack velocity and flow.
runner.method_input.pitot_dp_inh2o.process_note: Use the average traverse differential pressure for the current run when Method 2 helper calculations are being used.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.pitot_cp.label: Pitot Cp
runner.method_input.pitot_cp.short_description: Stores the pitot coefficient used in the Method 2 helper calculation path.
runner.method_input.pitot_cp.definition: Pitot Cp is the pitot calibration coefficient applied in Method 2 helper calculations.
runner.method_input.pitot_cp.process_note: Use the coefficient associated with the pitot setup used for the run.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.stack_temp_f.label: Stack temp (F)
runner.method_input.stack_temp_f.short_description: Stores stack temperature for the Method 2 helper path.
runner.method_input.stack_temp_f.definition: Stack temperature is the run stack-gas temperature input used in Method 2 helper calculations.
runner.method_input.stack_temp_f.process_note: Use the run-average stack temperature basis that matches the current Method 2 traverse inputs.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.stack_static_inh2o.label: Stack static (inH2O)
runner.method_input.stack_static_inh2o.short_description: Stores stack static pressure for the Method 2 helper path.
runner.method_input.stack_static_inh2o.definition: Stack static pressure is the run stack static input used in Method 2 helper calculations.
runner.method_input.stack_static_inh2o.process_note: Use the run static-pressure basis that matches the current Method 2 traverse inputs.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.baro_psia.label: Baro override (psia)
runner.method_input.baro_psia.short_description: Stores an explicit barometric-pressure override for the run.
runner.method_input.baro_psia.definition: Barometric pressure override is the operator-provided barometric basis used instead of a derived site-condition value when needed.
runner.method_input.baro_psia.process_note: Use this only when the run requires an explicit barometric override.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows
MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.co_dry_pct.label: CO dry %
runner.method_input.co_dry_pct.short_description: Stores dry-basis carbon monoxide used in stack-measured helper calculations.
runner.method_input.co_dry_pct.definition: CO dry percent is the carbon monoxide input used in the combustion/moisture approximation path for the current run.
runner.method_input.co_dry_pct.process_note: Use this only when the stack-measured helper path requires an explicit operator-provided CO value.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.co2_dry_pct.label: CO2 dry %
runner.method_input.co2_dry_pct.short_description: Stores dry-basis carbon dioxide used in stack-measured helper calculations.
runner.method_input.co2_dry_pct.definition: CO2 dry percent is the carbon dioxide input used in the combustion/moisture approximation path for the current run.
runner.method_input.co2_dry_pct.process_note: Use this only when the run needs an explicit operator-provided CO2 value rather than a live feed.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.h2o_wet_pct.label: H2O wet %
runner.method_input.h2o_wet_pct.short_description: Stores wet-basis moisture used for wet-to-dry handling.
runner.method_input.h2o_wet_pct.definition: H2O wet percent is the moisture input used in wet-to-dry conversion and crosswalk handling for the current run.
runner.method_input.h2o_wet_pct.process_note: Use this only when the run has an explicit wet-basis moisture value that should override estimated moisture.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.method_input.swirl_alpha_deg.label: Avg swirl α
runner.method_input.swirl_alpha_deg.short_description: Stores average swirl angle for stack-measured flow interpretation.
runner.method_input.swirl_alpha_deg.definition: Average swirl alpha is the run swirl-angle input used to interpret stack-measured flow when applicable.
runner.method_input.swirl_alpha_deg.process_note: Enter this only when the run has a defensible average swirl-angle basis.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows

runner.diagnostics_verification.technici.label: Technician / Operator
runner.diagnostics_verification.technici.short_description: Identifies the person documenting diagnostics verification details.
runner.diagnostics_verification.technici.definition: Technician / Operator is the named person responsible for the diagnostics verification record captured in the Runner.
runner.diagnostics_verification.technici.process_note: Enter the person actually responsible for the recorded diagnostics verification entry.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Worksteps - All Tabs and Flows
MOLE DAS Terms, Definitions, and References

runner.diagnostics_verification.workshee.label: Worksheet / Form Ref
runner.diagnostics_verification.workshee.short_description: Stores the supporting worksheet or form reference for the diagnostics verification record.
runner.diagnostics_verification.workshee.definition: Worksheet / Form Ref is the external document or record reference tied to the diagnostics verification evidence.
runner.diagnostics_verification.workshee.process_note: Use a stable worksheet, form, or log reference that can be audited later.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Terms, Definitions, and References

runner.diagnostics_verification.calibrat.label: Calibration Gas IDs
runner.diagnostics_verification.calibrat.short_description: Stores the calibration-gas identifiers associated with diagnostics verification.
runner.diagnostics_verification.calibrat.definition: Calibration Gas IDs are the gas-cylinder or standard identifiers used to support diagnostics verification documentation.
runner.diagnostics_verification.calibrat.process_note: Record the actual gas IDs used for the documented verification event.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Terms, Definitions, and References

runner.diagnostics_verification.attachme.label: Attachment Path
runner.diagnostics_verification.attachme.short_description: Stores or opens the supporting attachment for the diagnostics verification record.
runner.diagnostics_verification.attachme.definition: Attachment Path is the file reference to supporting evidence such as a worksheet, photo, or supporting record.
runner.diagnostics_verification.attachme.process_note: Point this at the specific supporting evidence file for the diagnostics verification record.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Terms, Definitions, and References

runner.diagnostics_verification.notes.label: Verification Notes
runner.diagnostics_verification.notes.short_description: Stores freeform notes supporting the diagnostics verification record.
runner.diagnostics_verification.notes.definition: Verification Notes are the operator-entered narrative comments that explain the diagnostics verification record.
runner.diagnostics_verification.notes.process_note: Use this for concise verification evidence context, not general run notes.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Terms, Definitions, and References

runner.diagnostics_verification.save_det.label: Save Verification Details
runner.diagnostics_verification.save_det.short_description: Saves the current diagnostics verification details into session state.
runner.diagnostics_verification.save_det.definition: This action preserves the current diagnostics verification form values without marking pre-test or post-test completion.
runner.diagnostics_verification.save_det.process_note: Use this after updating diagnostics verification details so the evidence record is preserved.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Terms, Definitions, and References

runner.diagnostics_verification.mark_pre.label: Mark Pre-Test Verified
runner.diagnostics_verification.mark_pre.short_description: Marks the diagnostics pre-test verification stage as complete.
runner.diagnostics_verification.mark_pre.definition: This action records explicit completion of the pre-test diagnostics verification stage in the session evidence.
runner.diagnostics_verification.mark_pre.process_note: Use this only after the pre-test diagnostics verification evidence is actually complete and documented.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Terms, Definitions, and References

runner.diagnostics_verification.clear_pr.label: Clear Pre-Test
runner.diagnostics_verification.clear_pr.short_description: Clears the explicit pre-test verification mark from the diagnostics verification record.
runner.diagnostics_verification.clear_pr.definition: This action removes the explicit completed state for the pre-test diagnostics verification stage.
runner.diagnostics_verification.clear_pr.process_note: Use this when the pre-test verification state needs correction or was marked in error.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Terms, Definitions, and References

runner.diagnostics_verification.mark_pos.label: Mark Post-Test Verified
runner.diagnostics_verification.mark_pos.short_description: Marks the diagnostics post-test verification stage as complete.
runner.diagnostics_verification.mark_pos.definition: This action records explicit completion of the post-test diagnostics verification stage in the session evidence.
runner.diagnostics_verification.mark_pos.process_note: Use this only after the post-test diagnostics verification evidence is actually complete and documented.

doc_refs.doc_label: MOLE DAS Terms, Definitions, and References

runner.diagnostics_verification.clear_po.label: Clear Post-Test
runner.diagnostics_verification.clear_po.short_description: Clears the explicit post-test verification mark from the diagnostics verification record.
runner.diagnostics_verification.clear_po.definition: This action removes the explicit completed state for the post-test diagnostics verification stage.
runner.diagnostics_verification.clear_po.process_note: Use this when the post-test verification state needs correction or was marked in error.
